name: DocuWare
description_en: DocuWare manages indexed documents and document-centered workflows in cloud and on-premises deployments. File cabinets hold stored records; trays support preparation before filing. Current features depend on the deployment and client: the new client is available in DocuWare Cloud, while the reviewed manual-versioning and tray procedures explicitly describe the classic client. Intelligent Indexing, IDP and Aura are distinct capabilities with different processing and usage conditions.
description_zh: DocuWare 在云及本地部署中管理索引文档和围绕文档的流程。文件柜保存归档记录，托盘支持归档前处理。当前功能取决于部署和客户端：新客户端可用于 DocuWare Cloud，已读手动版本及托盘流程则明确针对经典客户端。Intelligent Indexing、IDP 与 Aura 是不同能力，处理及用量条件不同。

core_features.explanation_en: Classic trays stage documents; clipping retains separate files while stapling PDFs creates one PDF.
core_features.explanation_zh: 经典托盘暂存文档；夹合保留独立文件，装订 PDF 则生成一个 PDF。

core_features.name_zh: 依客户端而定的版本行为
core_features.explanation_en: The new Cloud client uses automatic versions and allows restoring content with or without old index values.
core_features.explanation_zh: 新 Cloud 客户端使用自动版本，可选择恢复内容时是否带回旧索引值。

core_features.explanation_en: New-client document actions derive from cabinet permissions rather than per-list hidden buttons.
core_features.explanation_zh: 新客户端动作由文件柜权限决定，而非各列表隐藏按钮。

en: Evaluate a synthetic supplier agreement and certificate through indexing, controlled editing and recovery.

sections.title_en: Separate prepared content from a filed record
sections.title_zh: 区分待处理内容与已归档记录
sections.en:
The classic document tray is a work area before storage in a file cabinet. Its merge choices have different outputs: stapling combines PDFs into a PDF, while clipping keeps the individual files, including mixed formats. Importing a scan or related attachment is therefore not the same as creating the intended final record.

For an editorial evaluation, use a synthetic supplier agreement with a supporting certificate and a corrected agreement. Define which pieces belong to one record, which need their own identity and which metadata must be accepted before filing. Preview the selected order before combining files and compare the filed result with its sources. A searchable record still requires checking that the supplier and effective date are correct. Local scanning needs Desktop Apps and a connected scanner; none was installed. No import, scan, merge or filing operation was run.
sections.zh:
经典文档托盘是存入文件柜前的工作区。其合并选择产物不同：装订将 PDF 合成一个 PDF，夹合则保留各个文件，可包含混合格式。因此，导入扫描件或相关附件与创建预期最终记录不同。

编辑建议的评估可用虚构供应商协议、支持证书及修正协议。先定义哪些部分属于同一记录、哪些需独立身份，以及归档前必须接受哪些元数据。合并前应预览顺序，并将归档结果与来源比较。记录可检索仍需核对供应商及生效日。本地扫描依赖 Desktop Apps 和连接的扫描仪，本研究均未安装，也未执行导入、扫描、合并或归档。

sections.title_en: Treat indexing suggestions as data that needs acceptance
sections.title_zh: 将索引建议视为待接受的数据
sections.en:
Intelligent Indexing suggests index values and learns from confirmations or corrections across the organization. Its technical page describes an Azure service storing full-text extractions, index values and feedback. An on-premises DocuWare installation must register separately to use that service. On-premises document storage therefore does not imply every optional indexing operation stays local.

For the proposed agreement, map the intended fields and compare suggestions with the source before routing on them. Include two suppliers with similar names and a document where the expiry date differs from the issue date. A confident suggestion is not proof of the correct business meaning. Record the accepted value and a correction path. Distinguish this service from IDP extraction and Aura question answering when scoping an order or data-processing review. Exact retention, provider contract and accuracy for the sample remain unverified. No document or feedback was sent.
sections.zh:
Intelligent Indexing 建议索引值，并从组织内的确认及纠正中学习。技术页描述 Azure 服务存储全文提取、索引值及反馈，本地 DocuWare 要使用该服务需另行注册。因此，本地文档存储不意味着所有可选索引处理都留在本地。

建议协议样例应映射目标字段，并在据此流转前对照来源核对建议。可包含名称相近的两家供应商，以及到期日不同于签发日的文档。高置信建议不证明业务含义正确。需记录接受值及纠正路径。在订单或数据处理核查中，应区分该服务、IDP 提取和 Aura 问答。样例的精确保留、提供方合同及准确率未核实。本研究未发送文档或反馈。

sections.title_en: Check the save boundary in the selected client
sections.title_zh: 核对所选客户端的保存边界
sections.en:
The reviewed new-client version guide applies to Cloud only and supports automatic versioning, not manual check-out/check-in. In an installed editor, closing a changed document creates the version; saving while it remains open does not. Microsoft 365 web editing instead creates versions about every 30 seconds. A local editing link expires after 48 hours, after which changes are not stored back.

For the synthetic agreement, close and reopen within that period before relying on a multi-day edit. Check the current version and the intended effective content in the repository rather than assuming a local save reached it. When restoring history, choose whether to bring back the earlier index values or preserve the current ones. If a corrected supplier identifier must remain, restoring old content and old metadata together may produce the wrong record context. Intermediate versions remain in history. No editor, web session or restoration was operated.
sections.zh:
已读新客户端版本指南仅适用于 Cloud，支持自动版本，尚不支持手动签出签入。安装的编辑器要关闭已改文档才创建版本，保持打开时保存不会创建；Microsoft 365 网页编辑则约每 30 秒创建版本。本地编辑链接在 48 小时后失效，之后修改不会存回。

虚构协议若需跨日编辑，应在期限内关闭并重新打开。必须检查资料库当前版本及目标有效内容，不能假定本地保存已到达系统。恢复历史时需选择带回旧索引值，或保留当前索引。若修正的供应商标识必须保留，同时恢复旧内容和旧元数据可能造成错误记录背景。中间版本仍保留在历史中。本研究未操作编辑器、网页会话或恢复。

sections.title_en: Version configuration changes the record model
sections.title_zh: 版本配置会改变记录模型
sections.en:
The file-cabinet configuration guide keeps manual versioning in the classic client and requires the feature per cabinet. Enabling it cannot be reversed. A document ID stays the same across versions, while changes to the current version’s index values do not propagate to older versions. Version-managed cabinets cannot use the synchronization feature described there.

These conditions matter before turning on a setting for the proposed agreement collection. Determine whether another system expects unique index values or synchronization, and whether its reference is a document identity or a specific revision. Review historical metadata when explaining why an older version belongs to a different supplier value. A change to index data is also different from a change to file content; use the appropriate history columns. Do not generalize the classic manual check-in procedure to the new client. No cabinet option, synchronization or schema was changed.
sections.zh:
文件柜配置指南将手动版本保留在经典客户端，且需逐文件柜启用。启用后不能撤销；所有版本保持相同文档 ID，但当前版索引值的修改不会传播至旧版本。启用版本管理的文件柜不能使用该页所述同步功能。

为建议协议集合启用前，需要确定其他系统是否依赖唯一索引值或同步，以及其引用的是文档身份还是特定修订。解释旧版为什么带有不同供应商值时，应核查历史元数据。索引变化与文件内容变化不同，应使用对应历史列。不能将经典手动签入流程套到新客户端。本研究未更改文件柜选项、同步或结构。

sections.title_en: Review exported content, not only visible controls
sections.title_zh: 检查导出内容，而非只看可见控件
sections.en:
For the new Cloud client, cabinet profiles combine permissions and document functions no longer depend on the old per-result-list controls. Export covers printing, downloads, attachment sending, copying and external editing. It does not distinguish original output from PDF with or without annotations. Hiding graphical elements in the viewer does not stop an authorized original-format download.

For the synthetic agreement, inspect each role’s effective permissions and downloaded rendition before regarding a viewer annotation as redaction. Removing one export button from a list is not the same as withdrawing the underlying right across the cabinet. A copied document link is opened with the recipient’s own permissions, while a downloaded file is already a separate copy. The guide also says visible result-list index data can be exported to CSV without a separate permission. Test field visibility and actual output together. No role, download, CSV or sharing action was performed.
sections.zh:
对于新 Cloud 客户端，文件柜资料组权限组合生效，文档功能不再受旧的逐结果列表控制。Export 覆盖打印、下载、附件发送、复制及外部编辑，不区分原格式与带或不带批注的 PDF。在查看器隐藏图形元素，不会阻止获授权用户下载原格式。

虚构协议应检查各角色实际权限及下载呈现，再决定是否可将查看器批注当作遮盖。从一个列表移除导出按钮，不等于在整个文件柜撤销底层权限。复制的文档链接由接收者按自己的权限打开，下载文件则已成为独立副本。指南还说明可见列表索引数据导出 CSV 无独立权限，应一起检查字段可见性与实际输出。本研究未执行角色、下载、CSV 或共享操作。

sections.title_en: Restoring a classic-client document does not replay its workflow
sections.title_zh: 恢复经典客户端文档不会重放工作流
sections.en:
The classic-client trash guide covers both Cloud and on-premises. Deleted items remain for 30 days, still consume quota and can be restored or permanently removed according to the source’s permissions. A restore returns the document to its original location without triggering workflows, automations or notifications. This is document recovery, not a full tenant restore.

For the synthetic agreement, record its business status and expected next action before evaluating accidental deletion. After recovery, check the file, index values, access and outstanding review separately. Do not assume its return to storage also restarted approval or informed a waiting reviewer. Capacity planning must include recently deleted content; a delete request alone does not immediately free space. File-cabinet owners and ordinary users have different trash visibility, so locate the correct authorized recovery owner before an incident. The new-client trash behavior and post-purge recovery were not researched. No deletion, purge or recovery was run.
sections.zh:
经典客户端回收站指南同时覆盖 Cloud 和本地部署。删除项目保留 30 天，继续占用额度，可依来源权限恢复或永久移除。恢复将文档送回原位置，但不会触发流程、自动化或通知。这是文档恢复，不是完整租户恢复。

虚构协议评估误删前应记录业务状态和预期下一步，恢复后分别检查文件、索引、访问及待办。不能假定回到存储同时重启审批或通知审查者。容量规划需计入最近删除内容，删除请求本身不会立即释放空间。文件柜所有者与普通用户的回收站可见性不同，因此事故前应明确获授权恢复责任人。未研究新客户端回收站行为及清除后恢复。本研究未执行删除、清除或恢复。

sections.title_en: Aura answers depend on selected evidence and usable credits
sections.title_zh: Aura 回答取决于选定证据及可用额度
sections.en:
Aura configuration currently requires Cloud and the new client. Questions about selected documents remain available even when cabinet search is switched off. Cabinet search needs administrator-selected indexing; its included 5,000-document scope can drop the oldest documents as new ones enter. That removes them from Aura’s scope, not the archive. A missing answer therefore need not mean the underlying agreement is absent.

Daily credits are shared at organization level. Per-person limits apply with an individual limit first, otherwise the highest group/role limit; reaching the effective limit rejects further questions for the day. A group limit is not a shared group budget. The October update separately describes a general LLM API that accepts supplied text without document retrieval. For the agreement pilot, check the cited source, indexing period, permission and usage state before trusting an answer. Exact credit prices, model retention and answer correctness were not verified. No setting, chat or API was used.
sections.zh:
Aura 配置当前要求 Cloud 和新客户端。关闭文件柜搜索后，对所选文档提问仍可用。文件柜搜索需管理员选定索引，所含 5,000 份文档范围可在新文档进入时移出最旧文档；这是移出 Aura 范围，不是删除存档，因此未得到回答不一定意味着协议不存在。

每日额度在组织层共享。个人上限先采用明确用户限额，否则采用组或角色中的最高值；到达有效上限后当日新问题被拒绝。组限额不是整个组共用预算。十月更新另述通用 LLM API，处理所供文本而不检索文档。协议试点应核对引用来源、索引期间、权限及用量状态，再依赖答案。精确额度价格、模型保留及答案正确性未核实。本研究未使用设置、聊天或 API。

sections.title_en: Quote licenses, storage, add-ons and operations together
sections.title_zh: 一同核对许可、存储、附加能力及运维报价
sections.en:
The pricing FAQ gives a typical Cloud range of $30–$125+ per user/month, depending on user type and configuration; it is not a minimum checkout quote. Cloud uses annual subscription licensing. Standard capacities range from four users/20 GB to 100 users/1,000 GB, with extensions available. Specialized SAP, signatures and IDP capabilities are separately priced; included Aura allowances do not make the whole platform free.

The FAQ describes perpetual on-premises licenses, first-year support and optional later support around 20% of license value annually. Hosting, infrastructure and implementation still need scoping. General Business Terms grant restricted internal software use and limit modification; SDK and transfer provisions are conditional, not an open-source grant. Their historic license distinctions do not establish a current Cloud order’s renewal, cancellation or export terms. Obtain the actual regional agreement and quote before estimating the full term. No quote, trial, installation, contract or payment occurred.
sections.zh:
价格 FAQ 给出 Cloud 通常每用户每月 $30–$125+ 的参考范围，依用户类型及配置而定，不是最低结账报价。Cloud 按年订阅。标准容量从四用户/20 GB 到 100 用户/1,000 GB，可扩展。SAP、签署和 IDP 等专用能力另行计价；Aura 所含额度不意味着整个平台免费。

FAQ 描述本地永久许可、首年支持及后续可选支持约为许可价值的每年 20%，但托管、基础设施及实施仍需明确。一般商业条款授予受限内部软件使用权，限制修改，SDK 及转让条款附有条件，不是开源授权。历史许可区别不确立当前 Cloud 订单续费、取消或导出条款。估算完整周期前应取得实际地区协议和报价。本研究未询价、试用、安装、签约或支付。

seo.title_en: DocuWare: Client-Specific Versions, Export Rights and Aura Limits
seo.title_zh: DocuWare：客户端版本行为、导出权限与 Aura 上限
seo.description_en: Evaluate DocuWare using tray/file-cabinet distinctions, 48-hour edit links, original-file export, classic restore behavior and scoped Aura credits.
seo.description_zh: 通过托盘文件柜区别、48 小时编辑链接、原文件导出、经典恢复及 Aura 额度范围评估 DocuWare。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate DocuWare record handling in the intended client.
secondary_questions: When does a new automatic version get created?
Does disabling Aura cabinet search disable selected-document questions?
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no keyword-demand or ranking measurement.

content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation; proposed examples were not executed.
